headline: Without Cade Cunningham, Pistons get 21 from Isaiah Joe to hand Magic their first NBA Cup loss
text: ORLANDO, Fla. -- — Isaiah Joe had 21 points and Daniss Jenkins added 15 to spur the Detroit Pistons past the Orlando Magic 104-86 in an NBA Cup game on Tuesday night. With leading scorer Cade Cunningham out with a knee injury, Detroit also got 13 points from Ron Holland and improved to 2-1 in NBA Cup group play. The Pistons handed Orlando its first loss of the in-season tournament, preventing the Magic from clinching East Group A. Desmond Bane had 21 and Franz Wagner scored 20 for Orlando, which now must wait for Detroit, Brooklyn, Milwaukee and Toronto to finish the group stage before learning whether it has advanced to the knockout round. Joe, making his first start in a Pistons uniform after four seasons in Oklahoma City, scored 14 points in the second half. He made three consecutive 3-pointers in the fourth quarter to put the game out of reach. The Pistons built an 18-point lead in the third quarter and kept a healthy advantage throughout the second half. Detroit scored the game’s first eight points and, after allowing Orlando back in the game, took command in the second quarter. The Pistons used an 18-0 run to outscore Orlando 32-14 in the period and held Wagner to just two first-half points. Detroit’s Ausar Thompson had just six points but contributed 10 rebounds, seven assists and four blocks. He was key in limiting the Magic to a season-low in points. The Pistons have held opponents under 100 on six occasions, going undefeated in those games. The Pistons also outscored Orlando 19-9 on fast-break points. Up next Pistons: Host Milwaukee on Friday night Magic: Play at Washington on Saturday. ------ See AP’s full NBA coverage here

headline: Tatum scores 41 to help Celtics snap 4-game skid with a 131-116 win over Wizards
text: WASHINGTON -- — Jayson Tatum scored 28 of his 41 points in the first half and the Boston Celtics snapped their four-game losing streak by beating the Washington Wizards 131-116 on Tuesday night. The Celtics made 10 3-pointers during a 46-point second quarter. That gave Boston an 80-49 lead at halftime, and although Washington cut the deficit to five with a spirited second-half effort, the Celtics held on. The Celtics remained unbeaten in NBA Cup play, and Washington is mathematically eliminated. Paul George scored 28 points for Boston, and Neemias Queta had 21. Anthony Davis had 33 points and 13 rebounds for the Wizards. Kyshawn George added 24 points and rookie AJ Dybantsa had 20 points, 11 rebounds and seven assists. Trae Young scored 17 points with 12 assists. Queta scored 13 points for Boston before Davis, the opposing big man, managed any. That helped the Celtics to a 34-28 lead after one quarter, and then the bottom fell out for the Wizards. Boston began the second quarter with a 14-3 run, and the Celtics later went on an 11-0 streak — with three 3-pointers by Tatum — to lead 70-38. Boston faces Atlanta on Friday night, with the winner finishing atop this NBA Cup group. Washington had a three-game winning streak snapped. The Wizards haven't won four in a row since a six-game run in January 2023. Paul George left Kyshawn George on the ground with a crossover dribble, paused for effect, and sank a jumper in the third quarter. But by then the Wizards had already begun to fight back. Washington got the deficit down to 13 before the period ended. It was 117-112 after Dybantsa's bank shot, but then Tatum got free for a layup and Boston's Baylor Scheierman sank a 3 for his first points of the game. Up next Celtics: Host Atlanta on Friday night. Wizards: Host Orlando on Saturday. ------ See AP’s full NBA coverage here
